description: This file defines encoding functions and encoders for serializing various data types to JSON within the FastAPI framework, including custom encoders for data classes, enums, Pydantic models, and standard library types.

methods.name: str isoformat(o: Union[datetime.date, datetime.time])
methods.description: Converts date or time objects to ISO 8601 string format.

methods.name: Union[int,float] decimal_encoder(dec_value: Decimal)
methods.description: Encodes Decimal types as int or float depending on exponent, preserving numeric integrity.

methods.name: dict[Callable[[Any],Any],tuple[Any,...]] generate_encoders_by_class_tuples( type_encoder_map: dict[Any, Callable[[Any], Any]], )
methods.description: Organizes encoders by their class types for efficient lookups in serialization.

methods.description: Main function to convert arbitrary Python objects to JSON-compatible formats, handling various data types, Pydantic models, dataclasses, enums, and collections, with support for custom encoders and serialization options.
